0022600160.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-4, 0-2 at home) host the Atlanta Hawks (3-4) in this regular-season game, the Pacers' eighth of the season. Indiana is 12th in the East and third in the Central, three games back, and is on a three-game losing streak, while Atlanta is seventh in the East, second in the Southeast and half a game back, and has lost its last game. The Pacers are missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain) and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and the Hawks are without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), with Jalen Johnson (ankle) and Jock Landale (hip) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, the Pacers lost 1-2 to Atlanta in 2025-26, and in their last meeting, in Indianapolis, the Pacers won 129-124.
